Goal: HOME TAB Interaction with Left Navigation

The left navigation must now have 2 faces - one for HOME tab where everything is cross project and we can build multiple Session Manager Settings controls and behaviours that incfluence global behaciours. And the Left Nav when Non-HOME e.g. Project-Tab is active should be all about the current Project scoped down. 

Lets design this transition first framework level for having 2 independent Navs with indepentent settings and 2nd for each Tab we need to create a indepenent PRD so that it can profile in depth for Project vs. Global behaviour and sort them accordingly. 

Since the Global Nav is going to be something new and it will be combination and features from existing tabs to get started you decide on the initial organization. 

Write as many PRDs as you need there is no limit or cap
Still waiting on the background survey agent to finish mapping the LeftNav/tab architecture before I can write an accurate framework design and PRDs. I'll continue as soon as it reports back.
